snippet.title: Agefield High: Rock the School – Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Agefield High: Rock the School wears its Bully inspirations very clearly on its letterman jacket in this early-2000s-set, American Pie-era open-world high school game from developer Refugium Games. It's due out for PC (via Steam) in early 2026.

#IGN #AgefieldHighRocktheSchool #gaming
